test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A solid right-circular cylinder, whose radius of the base is 15 cm and height is 12 cm, is melted and moulded into the solid right-circular cone, whose radius of the base is 24 cm. What will be the height of this cone?
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the base of a cylinder (R) = 15 cm 

Height (H) is 12 cm,

Radius of the base of right-circular cone (r) = 24 cm.

**Formula used:**

Volume of a cylinder = π × radius² × height 

Volume of a cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

**Calcultions:**

According to the question,

A solid right-circular cylinder is melted and moulded into the solid right-circular cone then

Volume of cylinder = Volume of Cone

⇒ π × (R)² × H = (1/3) × π × r2 × h

⇒ (R)2 × H = (1/3) × r2 × h

⇒ h = ((15)2 × 12 × 3)/(24)² 

⇒ h = (225 × 36)/ 576

⇒ h = 8100/576 = 14.0625 cm

**∴ The height of this cone is 14.0625 cm.**
